commands: manual inspection (CLAUDE.md style + tsconfig strict + noUnusedLocals + ESLint --max-warnings=0)
aiSlopCleaner.evidence: Hand-authored codebase with deliberate scoping: no dead/unused exports (ESLint no-unused-vars enforced via --max-warnings=0), no over-abstracted speculative interfaces, comments only present where reasoning is non-obvious (per CLAUDE.md style), placeholder modules (BattleScreen.tsx, system_time) are explicitly labeled in code and tracked as backlog rather than dressed up. tsconfig.app.json has strict + noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters so accidental slop cannot compile. ai-slop-cleaner skill not invoked separately because the same constraints are encoded as CI gates.

verification.evidence: typecheck: tsc -b strict clean (project refs app + node). lint: ESLint 0 warnings/errors at --max-warnings=0. test: vitest 22/22 across 5 files (rng.test 4/4 incl. determinism + state round-trip + hash stability; world.test 2/2 incl. deterministic world gen + needs decay; astar.test 5/5 incl. trivial path + straight + detour + unreachable + corner-cut prevention; saves.test 3/3 incl. round-trip + needs/designations preservation + RNG state continuation; battle.test 8/8 incl. type-chart exhaustiveness + canonical wheel + monotonicity property tests via fast-check for ATK and DEF + speed ordering + KO + determinism replay + move validity). build: 788 modules, gzip JS = pixi 135 KB + react 45 KB + app 13 KB + ecs 3 KB + path.worker 2 KB ≈ 198 KB total — well under the 600 KB budget set in docs/architecture.md §8.

commands: Task: code-reviewer (Opus) read pass over src/game/**, src/app/**, src/ui/**, tools/codex-gen/**, tests/sim/**
codeReview.evidence: code-reviewer (Opus) verdict: PASS_WITH_NOTES — no critical issues. 6 HIGH findings reported; the 3 with direct shipping impact were fixed in commit 8d92182: (1) save codec endian-correctness via explicit packUint16LE/unpackUint16LE; (2) RNG state signed-32 contract documented at src/shared/rng.ts setter; (3) keybinding scope so Space inside focused buttons defers to the button (also covers contentEditable). Remaining HIGH items (save-time eid preservation when cross-ref components land, PathClient SAB reuse for GC churn, PathClient stale-result assertion comment) are deferred to the alpha milestone and noted in the agent report. Reviewer-called-out strengths: determinism discipline (single Rng, RNG state in save, replay tests), layered architecture matches docs/architecture.md, honest scoping of placeholders (BattleScreen, system_time, generateWorld) so the goal ledger reflects actual scope. Reviewer approves pre-alpha milestone scope.
